title: Conditional kappa 0.001672660197076918: rare-pattern T16 exchanges
body:
Conditional candidate kappa **0.001672660197076918**, **+0.000338096%** over PR1087 (0.001672654541898561). Repeated sixteen-bin whole-helper repacking, seeded through rare full-bin patterns, improves the idle-rank profile. The scalar word, role widths and source-event times are unchanged.

Published and revised as a draft before full verification, then passed the complete publication-package replay through the unchanged PR1087 strict verifier. All 69 admission controls, 12 bit controls, 15 controller mutations, six independent owner controls, two exact moment engines and 47 outer inequalities pass. The finite witness changes 193 role placements. VALIDATION.json records local evidence. Hosted CI remains separate; this reuses the checked PR1018 native baseline and PR1005 chain rather than rebuilding the full ancestry.

All-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact recovery, analytic transfer and PR589 bit H1-H5 assumptions remain. No unconditional theorem, global optimum or Lean claim.

Credit PR1087 and preceding owner-packing work by jeremykothe2 with Claude assistance; FanPUYen PR858; PR1018 including rohanarun PR987; PR1005; NewBArch PR869 and the retained PR799/741/685/645/589 lineage. Prepared by Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; new material Apache-2.0.
